S0642.reason: The state statute discriminates against nonresidents in violation of the Privileges and Immunities Clause, and no abstention applies since the issue is federal constitutional, so the court should hear it on the merits.

S0122.reason: The friend lacked the intent to commit the crime, so he cannot be an accomplice to burglary, but he agreed to the plan and can be convicted of conspiracy.

S0549.reason: Fetal hemoglobin has higher oxygen affinity than adult hemoglobin, so retaining it would increase oxygen binding in tissues.
